12K likes, 94 comments - ranveerallahbadia on October 20, 2026: "Something crazy is coming. Your phone does about 100 Mbps on a good day, and in the 2030s 5G gives way to 6G, with peak speeds of 100 Gbps or more. But faster downloads are not the game. 📡

AI has already changed how we learn and entertain ourselves. With 6G, the internet will start understanding your surroundings, and I think of it like a brain, with glasses as the eyes. Meta already has glasses out, Apple is working on them, and Jio is apparently releasing them too. VR can give you a headache, but AR puts animations and data points on the real world, and AR combined with 6G is going to change the world.

Knowing how the Ambanis think and operate, with the Jio IPO opening tomorrow, they are already thinking 10 years ahead. I am pretty sure Reliance is working on both these technologies.

#6G #AR #JioIPO #BeerBiceps".

22K likes, 82 comments - ranveerallahbadia on October 19, 2026: "If you had put ₹1,000 into Reliance’s first IPO in 1977, it would be worth about 50 lakh rupees today. 🇮🇳

Now India’s biggest IPO ever is here, the Jio Platforms IPO of about 30,000 crore, opening October 21. Think of it like Shark Tank: if you are the shark, look at three things. The business model, with 50 crore plus customers. The team, a Reliance-based business now led by Dhirubhai Ambani’s grandson Akash Ambani. And the moat, one of the biggest 5G bases outside China.

I am not telling you to go buy stocks. I am saying learn about businesses, learn about the future, and educate yourself so we can take India forward in this tech race. Reliance always thinks 10 to 15 years ahead.

Jai Hind.

#JioIPO #Reliance #BeerBiceps".

136K likes, 684 comments - ranveerallahbadia on October 17, 2026: "Tesla just showed a Roadster that flies. Remember the Eric Weinstein clip from 6 months ago? 🚗

He said human scientific progress has hit a J-curve, and flying cars are the beginning of it. BYD already built a car that jumps over potholes, and Tata and Mahindra are building low-cost EVs for India. My own theory is that Grok, especially a Super Grok only Elon has, already knows a lot, and it is helping his companies move fast.

I think India’s role over the next 10 to 15 years is to adapt this tech really fast and make affordable versions of it.

Would you buy a flying car? Tell me below. 👇

#FlyingCar #Tesla #BeerBiceps".

65K likes, 308 comments - ranveerallahbadia on October 16, 2026: "I have so much respect for Ajay Devgn, and not just because Drishyam 3 crossed 500 crore worldwide, his first 500 crore film after a 35 year career. 🙏

What stands out is how business savvy he is. I have started to believe that to reach the top of the Indian film world, you have to be business savvy. He owns a chain of multiplexes, NY Cinemas, and a VFX company, NY VFXWAALA. He also saw a big failure with Raju Chacha, where around 25 crore went in and the losses were huge, but he picked himself back up and kept moving.

Learn about his businesses.

#AjayDevgn #Drishyam3 #BeerBiceps".

200K likes, 1,190 comments - ranveerallahbadia on October 14, 2026: "Vidyut Jammwal is being celebrated on a global stage, and honestly this is my issue with the world of Hindi films: such a talented martial artist and actor never got the right opportunities here. 🙏

He comes from a lineage of Kalaripayattu, and now people are calling him the Indian Jackie Chan. As Dhalsim in Street Fighter, he has added a seriousness and grace to a character that could easily have been comedic. I met him once on the show, very humble, a true martial artist and a true spiritualist. As Indians, we should all watch this film for him. Jai Hind. 🇮🇳

#VidyutJammwal #StreetFighter #Dhalsim #BeerBiceps".

18K likes, 92 comments - ranveerallahbadia on October 12, 2026: "Navpreet Singh, an alleged narco kingpin, was recently deported from Turkey. According to the Home Ministry, he got Turkish citizenship under a fake identity and kept running a network that sent heroin and meth from Afghanistan into India.

Two things every Indian should know. Hard drug addiction can destroy a country’s youth, so stay away from it. And drugs reach India from two regions, the Golden Crescent in the west (Afghanistan, Pakistan, Iran) and the Golden Triangle in the east (Laos, Thailand, Myanmar), which I believe is even more dangerous today.

Honestly, the real solution is education and awareness. If someone around you uses hard drugs, discourage them, because knowingly or unknowingly that supply chain can feed terrorism against India. Say no to drugs for your career and family, and say no for your motherland too.

Jai Hind. 🇮🇳 Tell me what you think about the future of drug use in India. 👇

#SayNoToDrugs #JaiHind #BeerBiceps".
